title: Rename an exported function and update all importers (all-.cppm)
prompt: In this mcpp C++23 modules project, module partition `calc:geometry` (src/calc/geometry.cppm, re-exported by the primary interface src/calc/calc.cppm) exports a function `double length(const vec2& v)`. Rename it to `magnitude`, keeping its signature and behavior unchanged, and update every importer that calls it (including src/main.cpp) so the project builds and its tests pass.
